name: browser_enqueue_command_implemented
why: The only browser interaction tool currently has no implementation and returns an error, so I cannot enqueue navigation/read/click operations even if Safari gains a tab. Browser access is the purpose of this agent.

parameters.deviceId: string, optional extension/device identifier; empty string targets live Safari
parameters.url: string, required for navigate, otherwise empty
parameters.selector: string, required for click/type, otherwise empty
parameters.text: string, required for type, otherwise empty
parameters.key: string, required for key, otherwise empty

status: Granted as a schema and not resolvable to anything real (unresolved). Calling it returns that verdict and the nearest real capabilities, not an action.
note: If this tool takes an enum, each value resolves separately — one branch can be live while another is not.
